absolute_value.description: Get a number without its minus sign, for example -5 becomes 5.
absolute_value.name: absolute_value

parameters.description: The number to drop the minus sign from.
parameters.name: value

returns.description: The number without its minus sign.

format_number.description: Turn a number into a polished display string with thousands separators, decimal places, and an optional currency symbol or percent sign, for example 1234.5 becomes $1,234.50 and 0.125 becomes 12.50%.
format_number.name: format_number

parameters.description: How the number is presented: plain, grouped with thousands separators, a currency, or a percentage (0.125 is 12.50%).
parameters.name: style

parameters.description: The currency's three-letter code, like CAD, AUD, CHF or INR. Well-known currencies get their symbol (CA$, ₹); others are written with their code (CHF 1,234.50).
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: How many decimal places to show. Leave blank for the usual places: 2, or 0 for currencies like yen.
parameters.name: decimals

parameters.description: How thousands and decimals are written. With a decimal comma, a currency symbol follows the amount (1.234,56 €).
parameters.name: separators

returns.description: The number as text, with thousands separators, the chosen decimal places, and a currency symbol or percent sign for those styles.

max.description: Find the largest number in a list.
max.name: max

parameters.description: The list of numbers to look through. Text like "12.50" counts as a number, and blank items are skipped.
parameters.name: values

returns.description: The largest number in the list, or blank if it has none.

mean.description: Calculate the average of a list of numbers.
mean.name: mean

parameters.description: The list of numbers to average. Text like "12.50" counts as a number, and blank items are skipped.
parameters.name: values

returns.description: The average of the numbers in the list, or blank if it has none.

median.description: Find the middle value of a list of numbers. For an even-length list, the two middle values are averaged.
median.name: median

parameters.description: The list of numbers to find the middle of. Text like "12.50" counts as a number, and blank items are skipped.
parameters.name: values

returns.description: The middle number once the list is sorted, or the average of the two middle numbers when the list has an even count. Blank if the list has no numbers.

min.description: Find the smallest number in a list.
min.name: min

parameters.description: The list of numbers to look through. Text like "12.50" counts as a number, and blank items are skipped.
parameters.name: values

returns.description: The smallest number in the list, or blank if it has none.

mode.description: Find the number that appears most often in a list.
mode.display_str_template: Find the most common number in {0}
mode.name: mode

parameters.description: The list of numbers to look through. Text like "12.50" counts as a number, and blank items are skipped.
parameters.name: values

returns.description: The number that appears most often in the list. In a tie, the one that appears first. Blank if the list has no numbers.

round.description: Round a number up, down, or to the nearest value.
round.name: round

parameters.description: How to round: to the nearest value (halves away from zero, so 2.5 is 3 and -2.5 is -3), up, or down.
parameters.name: mode

parameters.description: How many decimal places to keep. Defaults to 0 (no decimals).
parameters.name: decimals

returns.description: The number rounded up, down, or to the nearest value at the chosen decimal places: a whole number when there are none.

standard_deviation.description: Measure how spread out a list of numbers is: close to 0 when they are all alike, larger the more they vary. The same as STDEV in a spreadsheet.
standard_deviation.name: standard_deviation

parameters.description: The list of numbers. Text like 12.50 counts, and blanks are skipped.
parameters.name: values

parameters.description: A sample of a larger group (STDEV, the usual choice), or the whole group (STDEV.P).
parameters.name: basis

returns.description: How far the numbers typically are from their average, or blank when there are too few numbers (a sample needs two).

total.description: Add up all numbers in a list.
total.name: total

parameters.description: The list of numbers to add up. Text like "12.50" counts as a number, and blank items are skipped.
parameters.name: values

returns.description: The sum of the numbers in the list, or 0 if it is empty.

description: Add, average, round, and compare numbers.
